items.title_cn: 内镜超声检查后胰腺炎风险：系统评价与荟萃分析
items.title_en: RISK OF PANCREATITIS FOLLOWING ENDOSCOPIC ULTRASONOGRAPHY: A SYSTEMATIC REVIEW AND META-ANALYSIS
items.abstract_cn: 内镜超声引导下的组织取样广泛用于诊断胰腺病变，但胰腺炎仍是一种具有临床意义的不良事件，且关于其危险因素的证据并不一致。本系统综述和荟萃分析旨在总结内镜超声后胰腺炎的发生率，并评估患者相关和操作相关的危险因素。检索了PubMed、Scopus和Cochrane Library中报告内镜超声后胰腺炎并评估危险因素的研究。在至少两项研究中报告且具有可提取二分类数据的危险因素，采用Mantel–Haenszel固定效应模型，以风险比及95%置信区间进行合并。共纳入5项研究：2项队列研究、1项多中心汇总分析、1项回顾性病例对照研究和1例病例报告。报告的胰腺炎发生率为0.29%至9.2%，反映了研究人群和操作风险方面的差异。仅2项研究提供了适合合并的数据。胰腺炎与性别（风险比1.13；95%置信区间0.48–2.64）、胰腺炎病史（1.50；0.60–3.75）或胰腺头部取样与其他部位取样相比（1.21；0.50–2.94）均无显著关联，且未观察到研究间异质性。在单项研究中，近期急性胰腺炎和分支胰管型导管内乳头状黏液性肿瘤与更高的风险相关。内镜超声引导下胰腺取样后胰腺炎并不常见，其报告发生率随患者选择和操作特征而变化。合并结果受到研究数量和参与者数量较少的限制。近期胰腺炎以及针道穿过胰管或正常胰腺实质可能识别出更高风险的患者，值得开展前瞻性研究。
items.abstract_en: Endoscopic ultrasonography-guided tissue sampling is widely used to diagnose pancreatic lesions, but pancreatitis remains a clinically relevant adverse event, and evidence on its risk factors is inconsistent. This systematic review and meta-analysis aimed to summarize the incidence of pancreatitis after endoscopic ultrasonography and to evaluate patient- and procedure-related risk factors. PubMed, Scopus, and the Cochrane Library were searched for studies reporting pancreatitis after endoscopic ultrasonography and evaluating risk factors. Risk factors reported in at least two studies with extractable dichotomous data were pooled as risk ratios with 95% confidence intervals using the Mantel–Haenszel fixed-effect model. Five studies were included: two cohort studies, a multicenter pooled analysis, a retrospective case–control study, and a case report. The reported incidence of pancreatitis ranged from 0.29% to 9.2%, reflecting differences in study populations and procedural risk. Only two studies provided data suitable for pooling. Pancreatitis was not significantly associated with sex (risk ratio 1.13; 95% confidence interval 0.48–2.64), history of pancreatitis (1.50; 0.60–3.75), or sampling of the pancreatic head versus other locations (1.21; 0.50–2.94), and no between-study heterogeneity was observed. In individual studies, recent acute pancreatitis and side-branch intraductal papillary mucinous neoplasm were associated with a higher risk. Pancreatitis after endoscopic ultrasonography-guided pancreatic sampling is uncommon, and its reported incidence varies with patient selection and procedural characteristics. The pooled findings are limited by the small number of studies and participants. Recent pancreatitis and needle passage through the pancreatic duct or normal parenchyma may identify patients at higher risk and warrant prospective investigation.
items.summary_cn: 该系统综述与荟萃分析发现，EUS引导下胰腺取样后胰腺炎发生率较低（0.29%–9.2%），且与性别、胰腺炎病史或胰腺头部取样无显著关联；近期急性胰腺炎和分支胰管型IPMN在个别研究中与更高风险相关，但汇总结果受研究数量和样本量限制。

items.title_cn: 发现用于治疗重症急性胰腺炎的新型STING抑制剂
items.title_en: Discovery of Novel STING Inhibitors for the Treatment of Severe Acute Pancreatitis
items.abstract_cn: 摘要：干扰素基因刺激因子（STING）是重症急性胰腺炎（SAP）的一个有前景的治疗靶点，但有效的小分子抑制剂仍然有限。在此，构效关系研究鉴定出化合物D4作为一种强效STING抑制剂，具有良好的细胞活性和安全性。D4直接结合STING，抑制其寡聚化及下游TBK1/IRF3信号传导，并恢复巨噬细胞吞噬功能、自噬流和线粒体功能，同时抑制NOD样受体家族含pyrin结构域3（NLRP3）相关的细胞焦亡。D4表现出口服暴露，生物利用度为24.70%，在1000 mg/kg剂量下无明显毒性。在雨蛙素/LPS诱导的SAP模型中，D4显著减轻了胰腺损伤、腺泡细胞坏死、炎症浸润以及血清淀粉酶和脂肪酶水平。STING敲低产生了类似的保护作用。这些发现表明D4是一种有前景的靶向STING的SAP治疗先导化合物。
items.abstract_en: Abstract Stimulator of interferon genes (STING) is a promising therapeutic target for severe acute pancreatitis (SAP), but effective small-molecule inhibitors remain limited. Here, structure−activity relationship studies identified compound D4 as a potent STING inhibitor with favorable cellular activity and safety. D4 directly engaged STING, inhibited its oligomerization and downstream TBK1/IRF3 signaling, and restored macrophage phagocytosis, autophagic flux, and mitochondrial function while suppressing NOD-like receptor family pyrin domain containing 3(NLRP3)-associated pyroptosis. D4 showed oral exposure with 24.70% bioavailability and no overt toxicity at 1000 mg/kg. In a caerulein/LPS-induced SAP model, D4 markedly reduced pancreatic injury, acinar cell necrosis, inflammatory infiltration, and serum amylase and lipase levels. STING knockdown produced similar protective effects. These findings identify D4 as a promising STING-targeting lead compound for SAP treatment.
items.summary_cn: 该研究发现化合物D4是一种有效的STING抑制剂，能直接结合STING并抑制其寡聚化及下游TBK1/IRF3信号，同时恢复巨噬细胞吞噬、自噬流和线粒体功能并抑制NLRP3相关焦亡。在雨蛙素/LPS诱导的重症急性胰腺炎模型中，D4显著减轻胰腺损伤、腺泡细胞坏死和炎症浸润，并降低血清淀粉酶和脂肪酶水平。

items.title_cn: 目标导向液体治疗与标准静脉液体治疗急性胰腺炎的效果比较
items.title_en: Effectiveness of Goal-Directed Fluid Therapy (GDFT) in Treatment of Acute Pancreatitis vs Standard IV Fluid Therapy
items.abstract_cn: 背景：急性胰腺炎（AP）是最常见的外科急症之一；其严重程度从轻度自限性炎症到伴有全身炎症反应综合征（SIRS）、器官衰竭和死亡的严重疾病不等。液体复苏是治疗的基石。然而，最佳的液体管理策略仍存在争议。目标导向液体治疗（GDFT）相较于传统经验性液体管理，提供了一种针对患者个体化、以血流动力学为指导的方法。目的：评估GDFT与标准静脉（IV）液体治疗在急性胰腺炎管理中的有效性。方法：在马哈拉施特拉邦一家三级教学医院进行了为期两年的比较研究。42例诊断为急性胰腺炎的患者被纳入两组：GDFT组（n=21）和标准液体治疗组（n=21）。GDFT组接受以每搏输出量为指导的晶体液负荷量输注并配合维持液，而对照组接受传统补液（5-10 ml/kg/小时）。主要终点包括安全性、并发症、ICU入住率和住院时间。统计分析使用SPSS v25.0进行。结果：招募可行性已达成（入组率56%）。GDFT组平均总输液量（8965.9ml）低于标准治疗组（9571.4ml），但差异无统计学意义（p=0.1691）。GDFT组平均尿量更高（5719 ml vs 4632 ml，p=0.06）。在死亡率或主要并发症方面未观察到显著差异。GDFT组ICU需求更低。GDFT组住院时间略短。结论：GDFT在病房环境中可行且安全，并可能在不增加并发症的情况下优化液体管理。趋势支持GDFT在改善生理参数和减少ICU需求方面的优势。
items.abstract_en: Background: Acute pancreatitis (AP) is one of the most common surgical emergencies; with severity ranging from mild self-limiting inflammation to severe disease associated with systemic inflammatory response syndrome (SIRS), organ failure, and mortality.Fluid resuscitation is the cornerstone of management.However, the optimal strategy for fluid administration remains controversial.Goal-Directed Fluid Therapy (GDFT) offers a patient-specific, hemodynamically guided approach compared to conventional empirical fluid administration.Aim: To evaluate the effectiveness of GDFT compared to standard intravenous (IV) fluid therapy in the management of acute pancreatitis.Methods: A comparative study was conducted at a tertiary care teaching hospital in Maharashtra over two years.Forty-two patients diagnosed with acute pancreatitis were included into two groups: GDFT (n=21) and Standard Fluid Therapy (n=21).The GDFT group received stroke volume-guided crystalloid boluses with maintenance fluid, while the control group received conventional hydration (5-10 ml/kg/hour).Primary endpoints included safety, complications, ICU admission, and hospital stay.Statistical analysis was performed using SPSS v25.0.Results: Recruitment feasibility was achieved (56% enrolment rate).Mean total fluid administered was lower in GDFT (8965.9ml) compared to Standard Therapy (9571.4ml), though not statistically significant (p=0.1691).Mean urine output was higher in GDFT (5719 ml vs 4632 ml, p=0.06).No significant differences were observed in mortality or major complications.ICU requirement was lower in the GDFT group.Length of hospital stay was marginally shorter in GDFT.Conclusion: GDFT is feasible and safe in ward settings and may optimize fluid administration without increasing complications.The trends favour GDFT in improving physiological parameters and reducing ICU requirement.
items.journal: International Journal of Drug Delivery Technology
items.summary_cn: 在急性胰腺炎患者中，目标导向液体治疗（GDFT）相比标准静脉补液虽未显著减少总输液量或改善死亡率及主要并发症，但显示出尿量增加、ICU需求降低和住院时间略缩短的趋势，且安全可行。

items.title_cn: 计算机断层扫描衍生的鼻空肠管尖端至胃窦路径长度与重症急性胰腺炎短期结局
items.title_en: Computed tomography-derived nasojejunal tube tip-to-gastric antrum path length and short-term outcomes in severe acute pancreatitis
items.summary_cn: 该论文标题涉及重症急性胰腺炎中CT衍生的鼻空肠管尖端至胃窦路径长度与短期结局的关系，但提供的摘要为空，无法提取具体核心发现。

items.title_cn: 儿童胰腺分裂的内镜逆行胰胆管造影：系统综述
items.title_en: Endoscopic Retrograde Cholangiopancreatography in Pediatric Pancreas Divisum: Systematic Review
items.abstract_cn: 背景：胰腺分裂（PD）可能与复发性急性胰腺炎（RAP）或慢性胰腺炎（CP）相关，但关于儿童PD患者ERCP结局的数据有限。我们对儿童PD患者ERCP的临床、技术和安全性结局进行了系统性综述。方法：检索了多个数据库，截止至2025年5月。主要结局为临床应答，由各单项研究自行定义；次要结局为症状缓解、技术成功率和ERCP术后胰腺炎（PEP）。由于结局定义和干预措施各异，且无研究纳入对照组，结局以叙述性方式总结，未进行合并分析。结果：共纳入8项回顾性研究，包含247例患者。6项研究中临床应答率为65.0%至93.3%，症状缓解率为19.1%至54.1%，技术成功率为77.8%至100%。报告的PEP发生率为7.9%至20.7%，患者和操作分母不一致。RAP的应答率为80.0%至100%，CP为60.0%至87.9%，在4项同时报告两者的研究中，有3项显示RAP的应答率更高。所考察的每一项结局的定义均存在差异。结论：现有的儿童文献无法确定ERCP对儿童PD患者是否有效。每项研究均为无对照的回顾性研究，且结局定义不具可比性。报告的临床应答率较高，尤其是在RAP中，但可能部分反映均值回归，且PEP风险值得警惕。鉴于证据确定性低及不良事件风险（尤其是PEP），需要进一步的前瞻性研究来明确ERCP在该人群中的作用。需要一套核心结局定义和前瞻性对照研究来确定疗效。
items.abstract_en: Background: Pancreas divisum (PD) may be associated with recurrent acute pancreatitis (RAP) or chronic pancreatitis (CP), but data on ERCP outcomes in children with PD are limited. We conducted a systematic review of the clinical, technical, and safety outcomes of ERCP for PD in children. Methods: Multiple databases were searched through May 2025. The primary outcome was clinical response, as defined by each individual study; secondary outcomes were symptom resolution, technical success, and post-ERCP pancreatitis (PEP). Because outcome definitions and interventions varied and no study included a control group, outcomes were summarized narratively and were not pooled. Results: Eight retrospective studies including 247 patients were included. Clinical response ranged from 65.0% to 93.3% across six studies, symptom resolution from 19.1% to 54.1%, and technical success from 77.8% to 100%. Reported PEP ranged from 7.9% to 20.7%, with mixed patient and procedure denominators. Response ranged from 80.0% to 100% in RAP and 60.0% to 87.9% in CP, and was higher in RAP in three of four studies reporting both. Outcome definitions differed for every outcome examined. Conclusions: The available pediatric literature cannot establish whether ERCP is effective in children with PD. Every study was uncontrolled and retrospective, and outcome definitions were not comparable. Reported clinical response was frequent, particularly in RAP, but may in part reflect regression to the mean, and the PEP risk warrants caution. Given the low certainty of evidence and risk of adverse events, in particular PEP, further prospective studies are needed to define the role of ERCP in this population. A core set of outcome definitions and prospective controlled studies are required to determine efficacy.
items.summary_cn: 该系统综述纳入8项回顾性研究共247例儿童胰腺分裂患者，发现ERCP临床应答率为65.0%-93.3%、症状缓解率为19.1%-54.1%、技术成功率为77.8%-100%，术后胰腺炎发生率为7.9%-20.7%；但所有研究均无对照组且结局定义不一致，无法确定ERCP在儿童胰腺分裂中的疗效，术后胰腺炎风险需谨慎对待。

items.title_cn: 2015-2024年巴西急性胰腺炎及其他胰腺疾病急诊住院与院内死亡的流行病学特征
items.title_en: Epidemiological Profile of Emergency Hospitalizations and In-Hospital Deaths Due to Acute Pancreatitis and Other Pancreatic Diseases in Brazil, 2015-2024
items.summary_cn: 该论文标题涉及2015-2024年巴西急性胰腺炎及其他胰腺疾病急诊住院和院内死亡的流行病学概况，但未提供摘要，无法总结具体核心发现。

items.title_cn: 整合单细胞与转录组分析揭示急性胰腺炎中铜死亡相关表型及潜在治疗靶点
items.title_en: Integrated Single-Cell and Transcriptomic Analysis Suggests a Cuproptosis-Related Phenotype and Potential Therapeutic Target in Acute Pancreatitis
items.abstract_cn: 急性胰腺炎（AP）是外分泌胰腺的一种急性炎症性疾病，治疗方法有限。铜死亡（cuproptosis）作为一种铜依赖性细胞死亡途径，是否参与AP的发病机制仍不清楚。我们整合了单细胞转录组学（GSE279876）、单细胞转录组学（GSE188819）和人全血转录组数据（GSE194331），评估了13个铜死亡相关基因在不同细胞类型中的表达，并结合伪时间轨迹、调控网络和细胞间通讯进行分析。研究结果在雨蛙素诱导的重症急性胰腺炎（SAP）小鼠模型及腺泡细胞损伤中，通过组织病理学、电子显微镜、流式细胞术、免疫荧光和生化检测进行了验证。单细胞分析显示，腺泡细胞中铜死亡相关特征被选择性激活，全部13个基因均上调，其中以GIs和Fdx1最为显著。铜死亡相关基因特征评分随伪时间增加而升高，探索性转录因子（TF）和细胞间通讯分析提示SPI1和AP-1（FOS/JUN）富集，同时伴有MIF/CCL炎症信号，这一发现在独立数据集中得到证实。在体外和体内实验中，SAP的胰腺组织和胰腺腺泡细胞表现出铜蓄积、FDX1/DLAT上调、线粒体皱缩和嵴丢失，这些均与铜死亡相关表型一致，且均被四硫代钼酸盐（TTM）所减轻。这些发现提示，炎症微环境可能与AP中腺泡细胞铜死亡相关程序的选择性激活有关，而使用TTM进行铜螯合可减轻胰腺损伤，表明靶向铜稳态失调是一种潜在的治疗策略。
items.abstract_en: Acute pancreatitis (AP) is an acute inflammatory disorder of the exocrine pancreas with limited therapies. Whether cuproptosis, a copper-dependent cell death pathway, contributes to AP pathogenesis remains unknown. We integrated single-cell transcriptomics (GSE279876), single-cell transcriptomics (GSE188819), and human whole-blood transcriptomic data (GSE194331) to evaluate 13 cuproptosis-related genes across cell types, along with pseudotime trajectory, regulatory networks, and cell–cell communication. Findings were validated in caerulein-induced severe acute pancreatitis (SAP) mouse models and acinar cell injury using histopathology, electron microscopy, flow cytometry, immunofluorescence, and biochemical assays. Single-cell analysis showed selective activation of a cuproptosis-related signature in acinar cells, with all 13 genes upregulated, most notably GIs and Fdx1. The cuproptosis-related gene signature score increased along with pseudotime, and exploratory transcription factor (TF) and cell–cell communication analyses suggested enrichment of SPI1 and AP-1 (FOS/JUN), alongside MIF/CCL inflammatory signals, which was corroborated in independent datasets. In vitro and in vivo, pancreatic tissues and pancreatic acinar cells in SAP exhibited copper accumulation, FDX1/DLAT upregulation, mitochondrial shrinkage, and cristae loss, which are consistent with a cuproptosis-related phenotype, and were all attenuated by Tetrathiomolybdate (TTM). These findings suggest that the inflammatory microenvironment may be associated with selective activation of a cuproptosis-related program in acinar cells in AP, and that copper chelation with TTM attenuates pancreatic injury, indicating a potential therapeutic strategy targeting copper dyshomeostasis.
items.summary_cn: 该研究通过整合单细胞与转录组数据，发现急性胰腺炎中腺泡细胞存在铜死亡相关表型的选择性激活（13个铜死亡相关基因上调，以GIs和Fdx1最为显著），并在SAP小鼠模型和腺泡细胞损伤中验证了铜蓄积、FDX1/DLAT上调及线粒体皱缩等特征，且铜螯合剂TTM可减轻胰腺损伤。

items.title_cn: 用于超快生物粘附和黏膜下注射的水凝胶
items.title_en: Hydrogels for ultrafast bio-adhesion and submucosal injection
items.abstract_en: Bio-adhesive hydrogels and lifting gels comprising sodium alginate and their use for preventing or controlling a gastrointestinal bleed or hemorrhage or sealing a perforation in tissue of a GI tract and separating diseased tissue from normal tissue in the GI tract, respectively, are disclosed. The hydrogel forms a calcium alginate barrier at the bleeding site, addressing the limitations of current endoscopic treatments for gastrointestinal bleeding which have limited efficacy, high recurrence of bleeding, and obscuration of the endoscopy view.
items.abstract_cn: 本发明公开了包含海藻酸钠的生物粘附水凝胶和抬举凝胶，分别用于预防或控制胃肠道出血或止血、封闭胃肠道组织穿孔，以及将病变组织与正常组织分离。该水凝胶在出血部位形成海藻酸钙屏障，解决了当前胃肠道出血内镜治疗疗效有限、再出血率高、以及内镜视野被血液遮挡的问题。同时可作为黏膜下注射抬举凝胶用于ESD术中组织分离。
items.summary_cn: 该专利由约翰斯·霍普金斯大学研发，提出一种基于海藻酸钠和CaCl₂的生物粘附水凝胶，在内镜下喷洒至出血部位后迅速形成海藻酸钙屏障实现止血。其核心创新在于兼具止血和黏膜下抬举双重功能：既能控制急性出血和迟发性出血，又能在ESD术中作为抬举凝胶分离病变组织与正常组织。优势在于减少多种内镜配件的使用需求，缩短操作时间，适用于难以精确定位的弥漫性出血和肿瘤出血场景。
items.assignee: JOHNS HOPKINS UNIVERSITY（美国约翰斯·霍普金斯大学）

items.title_cn: 用于机器人辅助手术的内镜多装夹施夹器
items.title_en: Endoscopic clip applier for robotic-assisted surgery
items.abstract_en: An endoscopic multi-load clip applier device includes a housing structured to include a compartment operable to store and distribute one or more clips; a flexible end coupled to the housing; and at least two grip components coupled to the housing and operable to compress and release upon control by robotic forceps of a robotic-assisted surgery system. The device enables multiple clip storage and automatic reloading, enhancing surgical efficiency and surgeon control in robotic-assisted surgery. The instrument can be introduced into an operative field via a bedside assistant port, and the surgeon can pick up the device using robotic forceps to place clips at the surgical site.

items.summary_cn: 该专利由加州大学研发，针对机器人辅助手术中血管结扎的痛点，设计了一种可存储多个钛夹并自动重装的内镜施夹器。核心创新在于将柔性端部设计与机器人机械钳操控相结合，术者可在不更换器械的情况下连续放置多个止血夹，大幅提升手术效率。该装置为一次性使用，成本低于现有技术，适用于机器人辅助的消化道手术中血管处理。
